scope: Dormant WorkerFactoryIdleTimeout semantic group; complete process objective remains active.

assumptions.assumption: Recorded class2 kernel behavior is the compatibility contract for the installed Windows build.
assumptions.basis: Four ABI profiles on one ARM64 Windows 10.0.29683 kernel; source/PE/module identity capture.; 8944 checked native observations, exact replay on all three hosts and actual owning class2 success.
assumptions.stress-test: All native buffer, access, signed boundary and cross-page controls.
assumptions.falsification-probe: Independent native checker rejects a rebound inconsistent status or normalized basic field.
assumptions.status: confirmed within one installed kernel and dormant contexts; other builds and active scheduling remain unknown

assumptions.assumption: No modeled request can be represented as None without inventing constructor timeout.
assumptions.basis: Existing dormant worker model has no queried default; native current default is not universal.
assumptions.dependent-result: Optional normalized timeout field and constructor initialization.
assumptions.stress-test: Unchanged state on every failed request; aliases and other setters.
assumptions.falsification-probe: Constructor/alias tests observe Some before any successful class2 call.
assumptions.status: retained: None records no request; constructor policy outside measured context remains unknown

assumptions.assumption: Shared memory read and one-shot guard handling implement the measured class2 capture order.
assumptions.basis: Existing checked Mem.u64 and guard_result; additional crossing native controls will test this.
assumptions.stress-test: Two-page guards/noaccess combinations and misalignment before guard.
assumptions.falsification-probe: Native replay status or protection differs for a page-crossing case.
assumptions.status: confirmed: cross-page replay reproduces native status and each page protection, including first reached guard consumption

bounded-findings.item: Both ordinary Windows programs advance359turns after class2 success to unimplemented NtQuerySecurityAttributesToken; neither exits successfully.
Five known Windows lowerer failures precede this group.
bounded-findings.evidence: Prior published flags full gate exact failure list

bounded-findings.item: Retained Assist Rust ABI184 and selected C++ consumers cover the linked process engine; whole current-root GUI/plugin/package validation is not established by these retained consumers.
